entry_item.definition: T. Rdo rje hchang; S. Vajra-dhara. "Thunderbolt-holder," the supreme god of the vacir (un) kølgen. Superimposed on the cosmic pentad ( see tabun burxan under burxan) he is the Angxan u Burxan ( see angxan) from whom all the deities, and the whole cosmos emanate, His is the fourth, the vacirtu bej-e.
